Both agreements are at no cost to the District, and the services run April 24, 2026 to June 30, 2028.

presenter: Measures N and H - College and Career Readiness Commission

title: CMAS Purchase Agreement – Audio Enhancement, Inc.– Lockwood Steam Academy -Public Address System Replacement & Security Enhancements Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a CMAS Purchase Agreement by and between the District and Audio Enhancement, Inc., West Jordan, Utah, for the latter to supply and install a new Public Address System (PA), as delineated in Exhibit A of the Agreement, for the Lockwood Steam Academy PA System Replacement and Security Enhancements Project, in the not-to-exceed amount of $52,589.02, with services scheduled to commence on May 14, 2026, and is scheduled to last until June 30, 2026, via the Division of Facilities Planning and Management.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Buys and installs a new public address system at Lockwood Steam Academy for up to $52,589.02
summary: The district is buying through a California Multiple Award Schedules (CMAS) contract, an existing state purchasing contract, instead of running its own bid. Audio Enhancement, Inc., of West Jordan, Utah, would supply and install a new public address (PA) system for the school's PA System Replacement and Security Enhancements Project, for no more than $52,589.02. Work is scheduled from May 14 to June 30, 2026.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: General Services Agreement – Ninyo & Moore Geotechnical & Environmental Sciences Consultants – La Escuelita Educational Hazardous Soil Testing Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text:
Approval by the Board of Education of a General Services Agreement by and between the District and Ninyo & Moore Geotechnical & Environmental Sciences Consultants, Alameda, CA, for the latter to perform three tasks (Scope of Work): 
·	Task 1 -2024-2025 Monitoring and Reporting Activities;
·	Task 2 - 2026 through 2027 SGMS (Soil Gas Mitigation System) O & M (Operation and Maintenance) Repairs
·	Task 3 - 2026-2027 Semi-Annual and Annual SGMS Monitoring Events
as described, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, for the La Escuelita Educational  Hazardous Soil Testing Project, in the not-to-exceed amount of $165,759.66 which includes a not-to-exceed contingency amount of $27,626.61 with the term of performance of services being for the duration of the Project, via the Division of Facilities Planning and Management.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Pays Ninyo & Moore up to $165,759.66 for soil-gas monitoring and repairs at La Escuelita
summary: Ninyo & Moore, of Alameda, would do three tasks for the La Escuelita Educational Hazardous Soil Testing Project: 2024-2025 monitoring and reporting; 2026 through 2027 operation and maintenance repairs of the soil gas mitigation system (SGMS); and 2026-2027 semi-annual and annual SGMS monitoring. The not-to-exceed amount includes a $27,626.61 contingency. The term lasts for the duration of the project.
vendor_name: Ninyo & Moore Geotechnical & Environmental Sciences Consultants
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
